finding_loop_readout_quality.leading_hypothesis: The legacy standalone factorial oracle predates loop-dynamics v1.4 residual-estimator quality gating and incorrectly expects a semantic regime from an estimator-unbound readout.
finding_loop_readout_quality.strongest_counterhypothesis: The v1.4 runtime itself regressed and should still infer convergence without explicit residual quality metadata.
finding_loop_readout_quality.discriminator: Run the same truthful/shuffled/no-reentry/lesion/rescue trajectories first through the historical estimator-unbound readout and then through an explicitly quality-bound residual estimator.
finding_loop_readout_quality.result: Estimator-unbound readouts correctly fail closed as READOUT_UNCERTAIN; with estimator id/version/uncertainty/age bound, truthful and rescue classify CONVERGING_FIXED_POINT while shuffled/no-reentry/lesion classify STALLED.
finding_loop_readout_quality.test_delta: tests/loop_reentry_factorial_regression.py updated to preserve fail-closed legacy readout and bind explicit v1.4 quality metadata before convergence/stall assertions

finding_hostinger_cmake_prefix.leading_hypothesis: System Python's posix_local installation scheme places pip --prefix console scripts under <prefix>/local/bin while the workflow exported only <prefix>/bin.
finding_hostinger_cmake_prefix.strongest_counterhypothesis: The cmake wheel did not install a usable executable despite pip reporting installation success.
finding_hostinger_cmake_prefix.local_discriminator: Resolve sysconfig.get_path('scripts', vars={'base': prefix, 'platbase': prefix}) under system Python and compare against workflow PATH assumptions.
finding_hostinger_cmake_prefix.local_result: Resolved scripts path is <prefix>/local/bin under posix_local; workflow assumption <prefix>/bin alone is insufficient.
finding_hostinger_cmake_prefix.repair: Compute the Python sysconfig scripts directory at runtime and prepend it, retaining <prefix>/bin and <prefix>/local/bin as compatibility fallbacks.

frank.delta: Preserve loop readout fail-closed semantics; do not weaken v1.4 quality gates to satisfy legacy regression assertions.
frank.next_test: Replace matched synthetic pressure law with frozen historical/runtime episode measurements while preserving estimator identity and uncertainty.

harness.delta: Standalone repo gates are part of the executable closure even when pytest does not collect them; gate-oracle version drift must be treated separately from runtime defects.
harness.next_test: Run complete standalone gate inventory on immutable current head and capture per-gate timing/resource/failure metadata.

claycode.delta: Hostinger Ubuntu workflow portability must resolve tool installation paths from the active Python install scheme rather than assume <prefix>/bin.
claycode.next_test: Require the new make-lane receipt to prove cmake discovery, pinned llama.cpp build, real model server readiness and benchmark execution on the self-hosted runner.

continuity.delta: A CI workflow PASS/FAIL needs scientific adjudication: failure from a stale oracle or environment path assumption is not evidence of semantic runtime regression.
continuity.next_test: Keep immutable source identity plus explicit failure-class receipts and fail closed on unverified remote rerun results.
